records.title: 平海海盗女王去世与继任
records.description: 正文明确海盗女王于1478去世，Tlaga Intun Bundi继任；1500是章节标题，不是其死亡年，后续反海盗联盟战争结束年仍未精确。

dateEvidence.quote:
-The anti piracy war against Pinghoi is finished by this time, with Bhuvauri, the Baashidi(Gawakihza and Bereega), Hon Sai, Chien Binhrung and Arawkelin all fighting against Pingoi and Sirtan after the death of the pirate queen in 1478 and the ascension of Tlaga Intun Bundi as the leader of Pinghoi.The war effort is hammpered by the refusal of Beeraga to cooperate with Gawakiza, resulting in a number of unnecessary losses and elongating the conflict, frustrating Bhuvauri-Beeraga Relations.

 Eventually Bhuvauri and Gawakhiza cut a deal with Pinghoi to end the war if Pinghoi ceases to attack their boats. The war ends with Pinghoi still in control of Cay Cam Sinh and lots of Lupulan territory but having lost their external islands to Bhuvauri, Gawakhiza and Arawkelin. Chien is also able to take the status as the protector of Kuta from Pinghoi. This peace deal dissatisfied Hon Sai, Chien Binhrung and Beeraga greatly souring relations between them and their former coalition members. Additionally, many pirates splinter from Pinghoi due to this war and the death of the queen, many of them would hide in the central ringlet isles for over half a century.

records.geometryNote: 文字史料不提供EU4逐省边界；政治、宗属及省级控制须另审。
